# Arcane Visions

Arcane Visions is a ceremonial and esoteric atelier based in the Virginia / Washington DC area, producing handcrafted ritual objects, symbolic art, regalia, and collector-grade occult works for practitioners, lodges, and private collectors of the Western Mystery Tradition.

## What We Make

Arcane Visions produces a focused, museum-grade body of work:

- **HOGD Adept Lamen** — the breast-plate emblem of the Adeptus Minor of the Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn, hand-painted and constructed to the Order's symbolic specifications. $1,500.
- **Rosicrucian Rosy Cross Bas-Relief** — a sculptural rendering of the Rose Cross of the Adept, executed as a bas-relief object for altar, sanctum, or collector display. $1,500.
- **Paschal Lamb** — the Agnus Dei rendered as a ceremonial and devotional piece, drawing on its Hermetic, Rosicrucian, and Christian-esoteric symbolic registers. $1,200.

Each piece is built to specification, by hand, in limited numbers.

## Traditions Served

Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn, Rosicrucianism, Martinism, Rectified Scottish Rite, Élus Coëns, Freemasonry, and independent practitioners and collectors of the Western Mystery Tradition.

## Craft and Process

Arcane Visions builds ceremonial and symbolic objects for serious practice and serious collection. Every piece begins with the symbolic source — the Order's diagram, the traditional rubric, the iconographic record — and is constructed in materials chosen for ceremonial life rather than display alone. Commissions begin with the tradition, intended use, dimensions, symbolic requirements, materials, and timeline; specifications are confirmed before production. The atelier operates on a slow, deliberate cadence appropriate to museum-grade work.

## Geographic Origin

Handcrafted in the Virginia / Washington DC area, United States. Ships worldwide.

## How to Inquire

All inquiries are handled by direct correspondence. Begin at https://arcanevisions.art/contact/ or write to info@arcanevisionsstudios.com with the piece, intended use, and timeline.
